messages:
lee-devex: Heads-up: onboarding customer hit a crash in our TS SDK when using function-calling + json_mode + schema validation.

lee-devex: Minimal repro in the sample app prints `value` as a string, then validateSchema throws `Expected object`.

noah-sdk: We have historically stringified structured outputs in the browser bundle to avoid prototype issues. That helper might be leaking into Node/E2E flows.

noah-sdk: Quick patch: export `parseJsonModeValue(v)` from sdk-utils and use it in responses parsing when `json_mode === true`. Will make it opt-in for now.

tara-qa: Please add an e2e covering both encodings (string and native object). Found the bug because our smoke test used an older router that returned strings.

noah-sdk: Will also add a small migration note in the SDK README and a snippet in the sample-apps readme:
```ts
import { parseJsonModeValue } from '@redwood/sdk-utils'
const parsed = typeof v === 'string' ? parseJsonModeValue(v) : v
validateSchema(schema, parsed)
```

lee-devex: Can we add a short-lived telemetry header `x-rw-structured-encoding: string|json` so we can measure how many customers still get string-encoded payloads?

noah-sdk: Good idea. I'll add it to the JS client and runtime team can opt into emitting it.

devbot: CI: js-sdk patch candidate 0.12.4-rc2 -> staging at 2026-03-25T03:00Z

lee-devex: Action items: @noah-sdk export parse helper + docs; @tara-qa add e2e; runtime to add header. I'll coordinate with the sample-apps PR. Thanks :thumbsup:
